metadata.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas secures contract extension through 2033

content.text:
Arm Holdings PLC (NASDAQ:ARM) CEO Rene Haas will continue to lead the computing technology company under a new agreement running through 2033, the company announced.
Haas will also become vice chairman of SoftBank Group.
Haas expressed confidence in Arm's future and said he believed in its people and strategy, adding, "I'm incredibly proud of what we're building and wholly committed to realizing Arm's full potential for many years to come."
Shares of Arm jumped over 13% early Monday morning.
The company said its role in global computing has grown under Haas, giving it a more prominent position in artificial intelligence.
As artificial intelligence drives demand for more computing power, the company sees an opportunity to expand its role in the infrastructure that supports those systems.
The company said it sees that expansion as a way to create long-term value for shareholders.
More than 30 million developers are part of Arm's computing ecosystem, according to the company.
